req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not throttle requests below 60 per minute for a single client. This implies that the system should handle at least 60 requests per minute without returning a 429 status code. The tests will verify this behavior by sending requests at different rates and checking the responses.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: All requests should return HTTP 201 status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

# Send 60 requests within one minute
responses = []
for _ in range(60):
    response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
    responses.append(response)
    time.sleep(1)

# Assert all responses are HTTP 201
for response in responses:
    assert response.status_code == 201

tests.name: test_rate_limit_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send 61 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: At least one request should return HTTP 429 status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

# Send 61 requests within one minute
responses = []
for _ in range(61):
    response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
    responses.append(response)
    time.sleep(0.98)

# Assert at least one response is HTTP 429
assert any(response.status_code == 429 for response in responses)

tests.name: test_rate_limit_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute, then send one more request.
expected: The first 60 requests should return HTTP 201 status code.
The 61st request should return HTTP 429 status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

# Send 60 requests within one minute
responses = []
for _ in range(60):
    response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
    responses.append(response)
    time.sleep(1)

# Send one more request
extra_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})

# Assert first 60 responses are HTTP 201
for response in responses:
    assert response.status_code == 201

# Assert the 61st response is HTTP 429
assert extra_response.status_code == 429
